Song data comes from VocaDB: the 10,000 highest-rated original songs (8,603 have a release date), downloaded October 20, 2026. A song's date is its first public upload, usually on Niconico or YouTube.

Voicebank dates are when the singer's software went on sale, which fans celebrate as the character's birthday.
